subject: checklist 17.20 / AIR-2026-045 — page 11 declared includes
problem: page 11 declared two includes whose targets are ACCESS-plane tables; the physical query service refuses every non-DATA table, so the page answered 400. Those tables have no physical rows at all: their content lives in canonical raw storage.
decision: the contract gained an explicit serving policy (migration 109): a table outside the Data Plane is served only when it says it is servable, and only to a caller holding the authority it demands. Deny by default; no table was re-labelled as DATA.

implementation.migration: 109_contract_table_serving_policy.sql — servable + serving_authority on contract_table_definition; KIDS_STATISTICAL_CARRIER servable to every reader, KIDS_RAW_DOCUMENT servable only with RAW_READ
implementation.service: ServingPolicy decides and serves: rows come from raw.source_record of the newest PUBLISHED snapshot of that table's dataset, projected to the contract's declared fields
implementation.query: ContractPhysicalQueryService asks the policy instead of refusing by plane; relation expansion silently skips a child the caller may not read; keyset pagination stays Data Plane only
implementation.capabilities: allowedIncludes advertises only what this caller may read
implementation.authority: raw.read now also maps to RAW_READ (application.yml, compose default and the dev env); READ_RESOURCE alone does not open raw documents

tests: ServingPolicyTest (5) plus the contract/page/keyset suites: 114 tests, 0 failures

rawIncludeRequested.meaning: an include this caller may not read is not declared to them; the answer does not reveal that it exists

incidentDuringTheWork.what: recreating the dev container to pick up the new authority map truncated every JDBC URL at the first ';' because the env file was sourced into a shell for compose interpolation; the API could not reach SQL Server for ~12 minutes
incidentDuringTheWork.recovery: recreated with `docker-compose --env-file .env.dev -f docker-compose.workspace.yml up -d --no-build api`; health UP, role map in effect
incidentDuringTheWork.production: untouched throughout; :8083/health answered 200 at every check
incidentDuringTheWork.lesson: never source an env file into a shell for compose; pass --env-file so compose parses it
